notes:
Experimental updater UX fix.

Keeps the GitHub update check visible long enough to be noticeable.

Shows a short confirmation when no newer version is available.

Removes the duplicated version number from the Release Notes body.

Replaces the skin-dependent text viewer with a standard Kodi dialog that has a visible OK button.

Streaming logic is unchanged from v1.77-v1.79.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
